description: Single command that runs ALL checks: code scan (429 rules), secret detection, dependency CVEs, config audit, taint analysis, and auth coverage. Returns PASS/FAIL/WARN verdict with deterministic hash. IMPORTANT: If verdict is FAIL or WARN, you MUST call remediation_plan next to get a section-by-section fix checklist — do NOT skip any section. After fixing, call verify_remediation to confirm ALL sections are addressed. Example: full_audit({path: '.'})
name: full_audit
